info.title: GT-Online API
info.description: Backend API for GT-Online Consults — project management, task tracking, invoicing, and resource management.

post.description: Authenticate user credentials and return tokens.
Refresh the access token using the refresh token cookie.

get.description: Verify the current session and return user details.
Get the currently authenticated user's profile.

put.description:
Update the currently authenticated user's own profile.

Only full_name, phone, avatar, payout_method, and password can be
changed here. Email, role, status, and payment_rate are admin-only.

delete.description: Allow user to delete their own account.

post.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Create a new member. ADMIN may only create TASKERs.

get.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Get all members, sorted by newest first.
ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Get a specific member by ID.

put.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Update a member by ID. ADMIN may only touch TASKERs.

delete.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Delete a member by ID. ADMIN may only delete TASKERs.

put.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Reset a member's password. ADMIN may only reset TASKERs.

get.description: List all projects, sorted by newest first.
Get a specific project by ID.

delete.description:
Deactivate a project (no hard delete): purges its resources
(Cloudinary files + DB rows) and sets status="DEACTIVATED".
Assignments and historical task/payment data are left untouched.

post.description: Assign one or more taskers to a project.

delete.description: Remove a tasker from a project (soft delete — sets status to REMOVED).

get.description: Get all non-removed assignments with project and tasker details.
Get all assignments for a specific project (admin view).

patch.description: Update the status of an assignment.

get.description: Get projects assigned to the current tasker.
Get fellow taskers for a project (must be assigned to view).

post.description: Upload an Excel/CSV file to batch-import task entries for yourself.
Log a single completed task for yourself (the 'as you go' path).

get.description:
ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: every logged task entry, filterable, with aggregate
counts over the same filter set. This is the only admin-side window into
task entries before an invoice is generated — /tasks/mine is tasker-scoped
and the duplicate/dispute logs only ever show the exceptions.

The caller's own task entries, including dispute_state — this is where a
tasker sees a task got disputed even if someone else's upload triggered it.

schema.title: Response List My Tasks Api V1 Tasks Mine Get

get.description:
ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: raw duplicate-upload log plus a per-tasker count, for
spotting a tasker repeatedly re-submitting the same task as a pattern.

post.description:
Claim ownership of a disputed task. Either party may claim; the other
party must then confirm via /confirm for it to resolve.

The non-claiming party confirms the task transfers to the claimant.
Requires naming both the task_id and the user being transferred to, to
avoid confirming the wrong thing.

Undo a confirmation: puts the dispute back to PENDING with no claim on it,
so either party can claim it again.

Only the party who confirmed the transfer can revoke it — the claimant
undoing their own win would just be taking the task back unilaterally,
which is the situation the claim/confirm handshake exists to prevent.

Two things close the door for good:
  * the 5-day window expiring, since reopening past it would only forfeit
    on the next sweep anyway
  * either entry having been billed on an invoice, because invoices are
    frozen at generation and must not be contradicted after the fact

schema.title: Response List My Disputes Api V1 Disputes Mine Get
Response List Disputes Api V1 Disputes Get

post.description: Generate one invoice for one tasker on one project for one period.

ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: invoice a whole period in one pass.

Works over the tasker x project pairs that actually have an assignment, and
produces one invoice per pair — a tasker on two projects gets two invoices,
because a single invoice carries one rate and one cap.

A pair with nothing billable is reported as skipped with a reason rather
than failing the run, so one quiet tasker can't block everyone else's pay.
Rates always come from the project and the tasker; there are no overrides
here, since a blanket override across dozens of invoices is not something
anyone should be able to do by accident.

Set `dry_run` to see the totals first — strongly recommended, since an
invoice cannot be un-generated.

schema.title: Response List Invoices Api V1 Invoices Get

patch.description:
ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: move an invoice through Draft → Issued → Paid/Overdue.
Only the status and its two timestamps change — the frozen `items`,
`exclusions` and money fields are never rewritten after generation.

post.description: Upload a file to Cloudinary and save metadata to the database.

get.description:
List resources, optionally filtered by project ID.
TASKER callers only ever see resources for projects they're actively
assigned to; ADMIN/SUPERADMIN see everything.

delete.description: Delete a resource from Cloudinary and the database.

AdminResetPasswordRequest.title: AdminResetPasswordRequest
AdminResetPasswordRequest.description: Admin-only: reset a user's password without knowing the old one.

project_ids.title: Project Ids
project_ids.description: Restrict to these projects. Omit for every non-deactivated project.

tasker_ids.title: Tasker Ids
tasker_ids.description: Restrict to these taskers. Omit for every actively assigned tasker.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Report what would be generated, and for how much, without writing anything. Nothing is created and no task entry is marked billed.

BulkInvoiceGenerateRequest.title: BulkInvoiceGenerateRequest
BulkInvoiceGenerateRequest.description:
Generate one invoice per tasker per project in a single pass.

A tasker on three projects gets three invoices, because the PDF template
carries a single rate and cap per invoice — one combined invoice could not
represent three different project rates.

BulkInvoiceLine.title: BulkInvoiceLine
BulkInvoiceLine.description: One tasker x project pair considered by a bulk run.

ConfirmDisputeRequest.title: ConfirmDisputeRequest
ConfirmDisputeRequest.description:
Explicit confirmation payload — the non-claiming party must name both the
task and the user the task is being transferred to, so a confirmation
can't be mistaken for a different dispute or a different claimant.

DisputedTaskInfo.title: DisputedTaskInfo
DisputedTaskInfo.description: Included in an import/entry response when a new dispute is raised.

DisputedWithInfo.title: DisputedWithInfo
DisputedWithInfo.description: Identifies the other party in a dispute.

InvoiceExclusions.title: InvoiceExclusions
InvoiceExclusions.description: Breakdown of task entries excluded from billing.

include_carryover.title: Include Carryover
include_carryover.description: Also bill work dated before period_start that has never been invoiced — typically a task that was under dispute when its own period was billed and has since resolved. Leave on unless you deliberately want a period-only invoice.

tasker_id.title: Tasker Id
tasker_id.description: Admin/Superadmin only — the tasker to generate the invoice for.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Admin/Superadmin only — overrides the project's default hourly rate.

payment_rate.title: Payment Rate
payment_rate.description: Admin/Superadmin only — overrides the tasker's negotiated payment rate (%).

InvoiceStatusUpdate.title: InvoiceStatusUpdate
InvoiceStatusUpdate.description:
Admin-only status transition. `Paid` stamps `paid_at`; moving away from
`Paid` clears it, so the timestamp can never contradict the status.

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: All fields optional for partial updates.

RevenueSplit.title: RevenueSplit
RevenueSplit.description: Revenue share percentages for each party.

TaskEntryCreate.title: TaskEntryCreate
TaskEntryCreate.description: Single manual task-entry request (the 'log as you go' path).

TaskEntryWithParties.title: TaskEntryWithParties
TaskEntryWithParties.description:
Admin listing row — carries the tasker/project names an admin view needs
so the client doesn't have to join every row against two other endpoints.

TaskOverviewSummary.title: TaskOverviewSummary
TaskOverviewSummary.description: Aggregate counts over the same filter set as the rows returned with it.

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description:
Fields a user can update on their own profile via PUT /me.

Email, role, status, and payment_rate are admin-only and excluded here.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: Admin-only: all fields optional for partial updates via PUT /{id}.
